title: VMware vSphere / VCF - Overview
description: Global health of the vCenters: alarms, capacity, top lists. Click a cluster / host / VM to drill down.

targets.expr: count((vmware_vm_power_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} == 1) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) or vector(0)

count((vmware_vm_snapshot_oldest_age_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} > 259200) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) or vector(0)

count((vmware_vm_tools_running{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} == 0) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_power_status == 1) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: vSAN health (worst)
panels.description: 0 = no vSAN / unknown, 1 = green, 2 = yellow, 3 = red

panels.title: Active vCenter alarms
panels.description: Active (triggered) vCenter alarms. Only present when an alarm is active.

panels.title: Clusters (click a cluster to open it)

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_hosts{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_hosts_effective{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_vms_powered_on{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_vms{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) ((vmware_cluster_cpu_demand_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} / vmware_cluster_cpu_effective_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) ((vmware_cluster_memory_demand_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} / vmware_cluster_memory_effective_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}))
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_ha_enabled{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_drs_enabled{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_drs_fully_automated{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_vsan_enabled{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_config_issues{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

panels.title: ESX hosts needing attention (not green, not connected, maintenance, reboot required)
panels.description: Empty = every ESX host is fine.

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_connection_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1) or (vmware_host_reboot_required{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_connection_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_connection_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1) or (vmware_host_reboot_required{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_connection_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1) or (vmware_host_reboot_required{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_reboot_required{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_connection_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} != 1) or (vmware_host_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1) or (vmware_host_reboot_required{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} == 1))
max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name, type, shared, datastore_cluster) (vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (1 - vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} / vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) ((vmware_datastore_provisioned_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} / vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}))

topk(10, ((vmware_vm_perf_cpu_ready_summation_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", perf_instance=""} / 20) / ignoring(perf_instance) vmware_vm_vcpus{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

topk(10, vmware_vm_perf_disk_max_total_latency_latest_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
topk(10, vmware_vm_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

panels.title: Swapped / ballooned memory
panels.description: Only VMs with swapped or ballooned memory (empty = none).

targets.expr: sum by (vcenter, vm_name) (vmware_vm_memory_swapped_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) > 0

sum by (vcenter, vm_name) (vmware_vm_memory_ballooned_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) > 0
vmware_vm_snapshot_oldest_age_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}

((vmware_vm_guest_disk_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} / vmware_vm_guest_disk_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) < 0.15) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}
